cls: Can we update the comments in this file to reflect the new strategy?

We also need a test for the case when `Write()` returns ERR_IO_PENDING, and tests for network errors happening during writes.
Can we also have a test case where the write does not complete synchronously (i.e. we test the ERR_IO_PENDING case)?
In this case I think ``` base::test::RunUntil([&] { return mock_quic_data_.GetSequencedSocketData()->IsIdle(); }); ``` should do the right thing. If it doesn't work, you could try adding a…

This pattern creates a risk of flaky tests, similar to using `base::RunLoop().RunUntilIdle()`, because it is not waiting for the specific condition that it needs to take place. Whenever possible, you…
For new invariant checks, CHECK should be preferred to DCHECK. See https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/styleguide/c++/c++.md#check_dcheck_and-notreached Also elsewhere.
